gloss: to send off, to see off

definitions.gloss: to send off, to see off
definitions.explanation: To accompany someone who is leaving and bid them farewell, or to dispatch someone to a destination.
To train and release into the world, typically referring to graduates, athletes, or professionals.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}す。
{駅|えき}まで{友達|ともだち}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I saw my friend off at the station.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}で{家族|かぞく}を{笑顔|えがお}で{送|おく}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To send off the family with smiles at the airport.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちを{学校|がっこう}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}してから{仕事|しごと}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go to work after sending the children off to school.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}の{日|ひ}、{先生|せんせい}たちは{涙|なみだ}を{流|なが}しながら{生徒|せいと}たちを{送|おく}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: On graduation day, the teachers sent the students off with tears in their eyes.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{人|ひと}を{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To produce many people for the world.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{選手|せんしゅ}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: This school produced a famous athlete.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}は{多|おお}くの{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい}を{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: This university has produced many excellent talents for the world.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{音楽|おんがく}{学校|がっこう}は、{世界|せかい}で{活躍|かつやく}する{演奏家|えんそうか}を{数多|かずおお}く{送|おく}り{出|だ}している。
examples.english: Japanese music schools have produced many performers who are active around the world.

examples.japanese: あの{道場|どうじょう}は{何十年|なんじゅうねん}もの{間|あいだ}、{強|つよ}い{選手|せんしゅ}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}し{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: That dojo has continued to produce strong athletes for decades.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE: {送|おく}る (to send) + {出|だ}す (to put out). The ～{出|だ}す suffix adds the meaning of dispatching outward.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{駅|えき}まで{送|おく}り{出|だ}す (see off at the station)
・{笑顔|えがお}で{送|おく}り{出|だ}す (send off with a smile)
・{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}す (produce for the world)
・{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}す (send off graduates)

ASPECT: ～ている indicates a habitual action or ongoing process of producing.
